title: The Letter About Max
setting: A family house with stairs and a front door.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily, his younger sister with long black hair

sentences.en: Yesterday, Sam put on his jeans and jacket.
sentences.zh: 昨天，萨姆穿上了牛仔裤和夹克。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket zips up his jacket in the hallway.

sentences.en: He found a letter at the front door.
sentences.zh: 他在前门发现了一封信。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket picks up an envelope from the mat at the front door.

sentences.en: He thinks it is bad news.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket holds the letter with a worried face.

sentences.en: He runs upstairs to ask his sister.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket runs up the stairs holding the letter.

sentences.en: Their pet was lost a month ago.
sentences.zh: 他们的宠物一个月前走丢了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket and Lily, his younger sister with long black hair look sadly at a photo of a small brown dog on the wall.

sentences.en: A strong farmer found the dog last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，一位强壮的农民找到了那只狗。
sentences.scene_prompt: A strong farmer with a lantern carries a small brown dog out of a barn at night.

sentences.en: Lily stops and puts her hands on her head.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily, his younger sister with long black hair stands still with both hands on her head in surprise.

sentences.en: Then they hear something at the front door.
sentences.zh: 然后他们听到前门有动静。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a teenage boy in blue jeans and a brown jacket and Lily, his younger sister with long black hair turn toward the front door; a small brown dog's shadow shows through the glass.
